notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: 1.56 Update Release
notes.notes:
We have great news for all European truckers. The 1.56 Update for Euro Truck Simulator 2 is officially here! Let’s take a look at what’s waiting for you on the roads of Europe.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/26b4b5c1ae38ceb9c5c2fff95fb53a2f0ccd8f36.jpg"]

Before we take you through all the new features this update brings to the game, we would like to thank everyone who took part in the Open Beta and reported issues on our forum. This really helped us fine-tune the update and make it ready for the full update release.
[previewyoutube="kPe_MJ0ciTw;full"][/previewyoutube]


Height Blend

The Height Blend effect is a technique used to create more realistic and visually appealing transitions between different types of terrains or surfaces, like grass, dirt, or stone. It works by utilizing a height map texture, a grayscale image that represents the elevation of a surface, to determine how different textures blend together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/89850dc579ee1f2b905957deff937c5e39f85bcb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7889041fa50eb974d1be6cb5279c3793124c7682.jpg"]

For example, where a grassy hill slopes into a rocky cliff, the height blend effect ensures the textures mix naturally based on the terrain's height and slope, avoiding harsh or unnatural edges. For map designers, it eliminates the need for many decals, which previously had to be added to achieve a believable look, saving time and effort.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d393b7798ee99de7fd6786957261ceefaa7581c9.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/51b79ccdab653daecafdcd8f050f400e5c35bd8b.jpg"]

Under the hood, our team has converted, tweaked, and visually checked over 1,300 materials from our library to ensure seamless integration. During our testing, we didn't observe any significant impact on performance. There is only a minimal increase in memory usage, caused by the newly added texture.



HS-Schoch Tuning Pack DLC Update

With this update, the HS-Schoch Tuning Pack is also receiving a substantial refresh and expansion! Our teams have been working diligently to update this popular DLC, adding new features and addressing many of the community’s requests. Let’s take a closer look at what is coming your way!

Accessory finishes: 

Chrome

Paintable (can now be customised in any colour of your choice)

Matte paintable (also fully colour-selectable)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/aea785917a382059cf48260fcef073e47bdbb7fc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bfdd82e858bacc40157e1e4a5be399f0cd5cfa61.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4339ce7c3d2f6f75403436eb4a9229aad8ac7f17.jpg"]

Grilles and Light Bars:

Roof bars will have new LED and non-LED versions

Front light bars will now feature LED, non-LED, and even strobe versions

Bottom grilles will also be updated, with slot-based options as well as an LED version 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3d81c0063b1bcd32c71b8c771b56c2ff71e42a2e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bc5db5266b172ad4266587efcf7357b950deb763.jpg"]

We are also bringing you two brand-new paint jobs. All of these new additions will give you more freedom to match (or otherwise) the tuning parts with your truck’s paint scheme and overall look!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/98f09f657e74814245217a9283aa813288895e2a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/68fe09e559f0b66f04d6dc3efabdb242e4f98d1f.jpg"]

Since the release of the HS-Schoch Pack, several new trucks have been added to ETS2. With this update, we’ve made sure to include bars for all the vehicles that were not part of the game at the time of the DLC’s original launch. We’re also excited to announce that big auxiliary lights will be receiving improvements, and this will be available to everyone as part of the base game update.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/75bcaf760387606c28507d7cbe555d6428b1faab.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/21978a23016f7854c4d93e0497bd362737c0d6c5.jpg"]

We truly appreciate your passion for customisation, and we’re happy to bring these improvements into the game. We can't wait to see how you tune up your truck with the HS-Schoch Pack! Read the full dedicated blog about the update here.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209461/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__HSSchoch_Tuning_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]

Special Transport DLC Update - CZ LOKO

Exciting news! With the upcoming 1.56 update, we will introduce new cargoes from the company CZ LOKO, a renowned manufacturer of locomotives, both to the Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game and also as part of the Special Transport DLC, allowing players to haul one of the heaviest cargoes we’ve ever introduced into the game.

In the base game, we will be adding the MUV 75 and EffiShunter 300 locomotives. While these aren't the largest or heaviest machines you'll encounter, don't underestimate them - make sure your truck is well-prepared to handle the load. The MUV 75 tips the scales at over 14 tonnes, while the EffiShunter 300 weighs in at a hefty 36 tonnes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e1476b504a8534841031330353a1498cede28005.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/27ed46e6a693ea3e274783463f22db212ef2ccbe.jpg"]

Our Special Transport DLC roster is expanding with a true heavyweight, the EffiShunter 1000, a massive locomotive built by CZ LOKO. Truckers will haul this behemoth on a lowbed trailer. Just how big is it? The total height (including the trailer) reaches an impressive 5.3 metres, with a length of 16 metres and a width of 3.1 metres. Navigating corners with the EffiShunter 1000 in tow will demand precision and nerves of steel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4a4e979a4658d7fd57ab556d07eedbd88b3b2dfc.jpg"]

Your truck will need a powerful engine for this job - the locomotive alone weighs 80 tonnes, plus another 10 tonnes for the trailer. That's 90 tonnes of pure challenge rolling behind you.  

You'll be able to deliver the EffiShunter 1000 along three routes: Berlin to Szczecin, Kassel to Hamburg, and Bremen to Travemünde. Each journey will be escorted by two escort vehicles to help ensure a safe trip from departure to delivery. Still, it's up to you to avoid any mishaps - and to keep this stunning locomotive free from so much as a scratch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/09ba298e2341fd087a84c5910a105085036a5f4a.jpg"]

Want to read more about CZ LOKO in Euro Truck Simulator 2? Take a read of our dedicated blog here.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/558245/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Special_Transport/"][/dynamiclink]

Schmitz Cargobull Trailer Pack DLC Update

We are pleased to reveal an exciting addition to the Schmitz Cargobull Trailer Pack for Euro Truck Simulator 2. Our collaboration with Schmitz Cargobull continues to grow, and this update introduces new trailer types and features that expand your hauling experience.

The highlight of this update is the Schmitz S.CS High Capacity Transport (HCT) configuration. This features two trailers connected with a dolly. Schmitz Cargobull now becomes the second brand in Euro Truck Simulator 2 to feature a 32m HCT trailer setup. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d491f64f7a98159f2cebe021468663d438789d33.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1aa403708176636f2d1c320ef8ef5565f83b6398.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a74fe3e00a3123c10599e336c57934ab0a1295d1.jpg"]

Also arriving in this update is the Schmitz S.KO City chassis, equipped with a steering axle, which provides greater manoeuvrability in tighter spaces. While this feature is primarily aimed at navigating urban environments, in Euro Truck Simulator 2, you are free to take it anywhere you like.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2a7da3c580603d11730a53e196703a0a61b5cbbc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/833c8c4a401cac798bf80c97b192be5304186115.jpg"]

In addition to these trailer configurations, we’re also introducing new lighting options across Schmitz Cargobull S.CS, S.KO, S.BO, and S.KI trailers. These lights proudly display the Schmitz Cargobull logo, adding an extra layer of authenticity to your setup.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/140e5e42320803a950a676228a89bc3ba7971478.jpg"]

Read more about this update at our dedicated blogpost here. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2833100/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Schmitz_Cargobull_Trailer_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]

Camera Zoom - Hold/Toggle  

The 1.56 update also brings a small but welcomed accessibility feature. Players can now choose whether the interior zoom function requires holding the key (the default) or can be switched to a toggle mode. This option not only adds convenience but also improves accessibility, offering a more comfortable way for all players to take a closer look at the details inside their cab, in the mirrors, and around their truck. Players can find this feature in "Options → Gameplay and Options → Accessibility".

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/28f363533c6460fdd6671cefd1ed081c3bbd0ea0.jpg"]

DLC Browser

We are also introducing a brand-new design for the DLC Browser. This redesign aims to make browsing and discovering additional content for your game easier and more enjoyable. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c5d3715b257a2fbe3ccbb7dc249d9cb7c7c1c5f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/589c293d4d1db2abf4044328666df38de89e411f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/45913f978c8a1f58fefb5b7ac56e10e98fbe6396.jpg"]

The updated browser now features improved categorization, with clear sections such as Featured, Bundles, Map, Cargo, Trailer, Accessories, and Paint Jobs. The main layout has been completely redesigned, increasing the number of items displayed per row from three to four for a cleaner and more modern look.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6d051d642cff6d9158c5215070c686f8b822a88c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4e6fdddb810b70b068573b6711c2190b491bb473.jpg"]

The DLC browser is just the beginning of a feature with the potential to grow and evolve further. While it may take time and further development to see how far it can go, the vision is to make it possible for players to explore and enjoy all our DLCs without ever leaving the game. We plan to continue gathering feedback, and this feature might get some future adjustments.



Career Creation and Start-up Flow

We gave the career system a big refresh, which includes a new UI design and improved navigation. The old table-style list of careers has been replaced with larger, card-like slots that give a cleaner and more modern look. Your active career will always appear at the top, with your other careers sorted by most recent playtime. The first slot is reserved for starting a brand-new career, and switching between your careers is now quicker; simply double-click on a card to jump right in.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8ec9a25101563b380876c4ecf1b5550bf8f12a4b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/379e953109a4dffcd32f91010c8d47b002df14c2.jpg"]

Whether you're a new player or a seasoned veteran, the career creation process has also been redesigned to be simpler and clearer, focusing only on the most important options and selections needed when starting a new career.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/19b91f94a6d936442322298e48f8e4b2915e0f8e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a92f37fb3cdd1af4f94950df1219c5a4e7da5d5f.jpg"]

A new Truck Preference screen has also been added between selecting your headquarters and the opening cutscene. Here, you can preview all available trucks in a rotating 3D view that spins automatically, or you can rotate them yourself. You'll be able to cycle through brands, switch between different models, or even press a “random” button to let the game surprise you. We hope this new preference screen gives both new and experienced players a detailed look at each truck and its key specifications.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a80c9cc42018795ea35389fbb3b1fb07f00ae655.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e43a6c29e00b16a299821bc4d7b998726b5c05ec.jpg"]

We've also refreshed the Edit Career screen, which now focuses only on details that really matter for your career. Many of the older fields have been moved elsewhere, keeping the editing process simple and uncluttered. To make things more convenient, clicking on your career from the desktop top bar now opens a new Driver Details screen, where you can view all the important info about your career and even change your avatar without having to return to the title screen.

This redesigned approach not only makes career navigation smoother but also gives the whole experience a cleaner, more modern feel. Whether you're starting your very first trucking journey or managing multiple careers, we hope this update makes your career management more streamlined and accessible. As we gather more input, this feature could see further improvements down the road.



Management UI/UX Improvements  

In the Company tab on the Desktop, the Driver, Trailer, Truck, and Garage Manager screens now feature a redesigned company subscreen. The refreshed company subscreen shows the company name and logo alongside key statistics, a redesigned seven-day profit graph, and highlights of the most profitable assets. It also introduces an economy summary pop-up for quick performance review and a company properties option for editing the name and logo.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9f3a6576e278ffd8ceaa861dd02803c7e040820b.jpg"]

We've also added a quality-of-life improvement to the relocation screen: when both a driver and their truck can be placed in the same garage slot, a checkbox allows relocating them together in one step. To improve accessibility, the Garage Manager and Driver Manager are now unlocked from the very start of the game, rather than only after purchasing a truck.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/83d76c3268ec709d4fda9702f1ae563433a5a170.jpg"]

Finally, the Driver Manager subscreen has been polished with a clearer layout, including a new XP bar that lets players track their NPC drivers' progress, and a simplified job information and skills overview, where you can assign a collective preferred training policy for newly hired drivers. Our plan is to keep gathering feedback, so in the future, this feature might be further refined.  



Changelog  

Gameplay

Camera Zoom - Hold/Toggle

Vehicles

HS-Schoch Tuning Pack DLC Update

Special Transport DLC Update - CZ LOKO

Schmitz Cargobull Trailer Pack DLC Update 

Visual

Height Blend

UI

New Career Creation and Start-up Flow

Management UI/UX Improvements

Other

DLC Browser

Make sure to stay tuned for more updates from Euro Truck Simulator 2 by following us on X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky, and TikTok, or by subscribing to our newsletter! Until then, we wish you safe travels and, as always, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: 1.56 Update Open Beta

Whether you're a new player or a seasoned veteran, the profile creation process has also been redesigned to be simpler and clearer, focusing only on the most important options and selections needed when starting a new career.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/379e953109a4dffcd32f91010c8d47b002df14c2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/19b91f94a6d936442322298e48f8e4b2915e0f8e.jpg"]

A new Truck Preference screen has also been added between selecting your headquarters and the opening cutscene. Here, you can preview all available trucks in a rotating 3D view that spins automatically, or rotate them yourself. You'll be able to cycle through brands, switch between different models, or even press a “random” button to let the game surprise you. We hope this new preference screen gives both new and experienced players a detailed look at each truck and its key specifications.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a92f37fb3cdd1af4f94950df1219c5a4e7da5d5f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a80c9cc42018795ea35389fbb3b1fb07f00ae655.jpg"]

We've also refreshed the Edit Profile screen, which now focuses only on details that really matter for your career. Many of the older fields have been moved elsewhere, keeping the editing process uncluttered and straight forward. To make things more convenient, clicking on your profile from the desktop top bar now opens a new Driver Details screen, where you can view all the important info about your career and even change your avatar without having to return to the title screen.

This redesigned approach not only makes profile navigation smoother but also gives the whole experience a cleaner, more modern feel. Whether you're starting your very first trucking journey or managing multiple careers, we hope this update makes your profile management more streamlined and accessible. Please note that this feature is still very much under development.

Management UI/UX Improvements

In the company tab on the desktop, the driver, trailer, truck, and garage manager screens now feature a redesigned company subscreen. The refreshed company subscreen shows the company name and logo alongside key statistics, a redesigned seven-day profit graph, and highlights of the most profitable assets. It also introduces an economy summary pop-up for quick performance review and a company properties option for editing the name and logo.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9f3a6576e278ffd8ceaa861dd02803c7e040820b.jpg"]We've also added a quality-of-life improvement to the relocation screen: when both a driver and their truck can be placed in the same garage slot, a checkbox allows relocating them together in one step. To improve accessibility, the garage manager and driver manager are now unlocked from the very start of the game, rather than only after purchasing a truck.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/83d76c3268ec709d4fda9702f1ae563433a5a170.jpg"]Finally, the driver manager subscreen has been polished with a clearer layout, including a new XP bar that lets players track their NPC drivers' progress, and a simplified job information and skills overview, where you can assign a collective preferred training policy for newly hired drivers. Please remember that this feature is still deep in the work-in-progress stage.



Changelog 

Gameplay

Camera Zoom - Hold/Toggle

Vehicles

HS-Schoch Tuning Pack DLC Update

Special Transport DLC Update - CZ LOKO

Schmitz Cargobull Trailer Pack DLC Update 

Visual

New Profile Creation and Start-up Flow

So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'd appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in the dedicated section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in this Open Beta, you can find this version in the Experimental Beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on Euro Truck Simulator 2 → Properties → Betas tab → Beta Participation drop down menu → public_beta. No password is required. Sometimes you will have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.

notes.title: 1.56 Update: CZ LOKO Locomotives
notes.notes:
Exciting news! With the upcoming 1.56 update, we will introduce new cargoes from the company CZ LOKO, a renowned manufacturer of locomotives, both to the Euro Truck Simulator 2 base game and also as part of the Special Transport DLC!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d56586bff04ede572ce726af62aa91fb5cb7f565.jpg"]

We are very excited that we can welcome CZ LOKO to the world of Euro Truck Simulator 2, and we'd like to thank them for allowing us to bring their impressive locomotives into the game, giving players the chance to haul them across Europe in true trucking style!

In the base game, we will be adding the locomotives MUV 75 and EffiShunter 300. While these aren't the largest or heaviest machines you'll encounter, don't underestimate them - make sure your truck is well-prepared to handle the load. The MUV 75 tips the scales at over 14 tonnes, while the EffiShunter 300 weighs in at a hefty 36 tonnes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c3d3e2e20b6f96b9d75ac0f434a71c57d173c96d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/70b57071860ae0249c9302ebceb1b11013f265d3.jpg"]

The Special Transport already features oversized cargoes such as the Articulated Hauler, Large Reservoir Tank, Giant Silo, and many more. Now, the roster is expanding with a true heavyweight - the EffiShunter 1000, a massive locomotive built by CZ LOKO.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/aa8c5a55359aaa9ceb601a779d0ba31a67b61636.jpg"]

Truckers will haul this behemoth on a lowbed trailer. Just how big is it? The total height (including the trailer) reaches an impressive 5.3 metres, with a length of 16 metres and a width of 3.1 metres. Navigating corners with the EffiShunter 1000 in tow will demand precision and nerves of steel.

Your truck will need a powerful engine for this job - the locomotive alone weighs 80 tonnes, plus another 10 tonnes for the trailer. That's 90 tonnes of pure challenge rolling behind you.

You'll be able to deliver the EffiShunter 1000 along three routes: Berlin to Szczecin, Kassel to Hamburg, and Bremen to Travemünde. Each journey will be escorted by two escort vehicles to help ensure a safe trip from departure to delivery. Still, it's up to you to avoid any mishaps - and to keep this stunning locomotive free from so much as a scratch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/78d619c9f0629768c90020e50903a81a9ad075d8.jpg"]

Although the EffiShunter 300 and EffiShunter 1000 are inspired by real locomotive models, we recreated them based on CZ LOKO's design concept to reflect the company's vision for the future. This means you'll get to transport machines that haven’t even entered real-world production yet!

Remember that if you want to haul this beauty of a cargo, you will need to own the Special Transport DLC. Don't have it yet? You can grab it anytime on Steam and gain access to a whole range of oversized loads. And when the 1.56 update rolls out, the EffiShunter 1000 will be added to the DLC for free. 

Don't forget to give our X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky, and TikTok a follow as you'll receive updates about our games straight to your feed, or subscribe to our newsletter to stay informed! We look forward to sharing more with you in the future.

notes.title: 1.56 Update: Schmitz Cargobull Update
notes.notes:
With the release of update 1.56, we are pleased to reveal an exciting addition to the Euro Truck Simulator 2 – Schmitz Cargobull Trailer Pack. Our collaboration with Schmitz Cargobull continues to grow, and this update introduces new trailer types and features that expand your hauling experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d79c8d283f9e26e4f1f2897fee214a4d3623f2a5.jpg"]

The highlight of this update is the Schmitz S.CS High Capacity Transport (HCT). This configuration features two trailers connected with a dolly. Schmitz Cargobull now becomes the second brand in Euro Truck Simulator 2 to feature a 32 m HCT trailer setup.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6cafac13d5b8af2b9f49de0b896e821f634005f7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2203691304b51f6e9ab17a3e5176a5ea2aa8e595.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bf9bf40a61f05be269315addc7de458b530852a8.jpg"]

Also arriving in this update is the Schmitz S.KO City chassis, equipped with a steering axle, which provides greater manoeuvrability in tighter spaces. While this feature is primarily aimed at navigating urban environments, in Euro Truck Simulator 2, you are free to take it anywhere you like. Whether threading through narrow streets or tackling longer journeys, this new option adds variety and flexibility to your trailer fleet.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7d73c2664fd05e5036f63f33e9b50f199c28e3b3.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/acc6011ed2393d54e8411378a9160bbcc52578ee.jpg"]

In addition to these trailer configurations, we’re also introducing new lighting options across Schmitz Cargobull S.CS, S.KO, S.BO, and S.KI trailers. These lights proudly display the Schmitz Cargobull logo, adding an extra layer of authenticity to your setup.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b889106b4e6dfad24b578a402e132de8b364d925.jpg"]

We’ve got plenty more to share as update 1.56 gets closer, so keep an eye out for the latest reveals. Make sure to follow us on X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky, and TikTok, or subscribe to our newsletter for more behind-the-scenes content, updates, and announcements. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: ETS2: Farm Machinery DLC Release
notes.notes:
It’s time to trade city skylines and highways for dusty roads and countryside! Today, we’re excited to announce the release of the Farm Machinery DLC, a new cargo pack for Euro Truck Simulator 2!

[previewyoutube="De2mKz2uA2o;full"][/previewyoutube]
 Agriculture plays a vital role in Europe’s landscape, economy, and culture. From small family farms to large industrial operations, farmers depend on a wide range of equipment to keep their fields productive, but none of it would arrive without you, the trucker, delivering it. Take on the challenge of hauling powerful tractors and other machinery built for the biggest jobs in modern farming.   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/961534a64561c4fd8ecdd663c9227e0b8ce7055c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/8b5555a9d3517fb4c74edfa5411a3c35ba528c2d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3fd1ce8bab91b77cfce80256a5d15558b26216ed.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/030972c82543af523502b7b3e975598f843c58e4.jpg"]
The Farm Machinery DLC for ETS2 features 9 cargo types to haul, represented by our in-game brands Owl and Greenler. After finding success in American Truck Simulator, these brands are now making their mark in the European market. Each machine has been designed with detail by our talented vehicles and art teams, offering drivers a fresh set of hauling challenges across the diverse road network of Euro Truck Simulator 2.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7f692f1ac834a22f4c373e210bfb562fc83f5920.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9ed97478da20cda6e30422f3c777339b68947e35.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/0adaac9ae08ecda289a6c5e9840ca01c218d4234.jpg"]
So what cargoes are included in this pack? Get ready to haul: 

Autonomous Tractor

Articulated Crawler Tractor

Forage Harvester

Grain Trailer

Square Baler

Disc Harrows

Fertilizer Spreader

Planter Sprayer

Seeding Combinations


But there’s more to this DLC than just what's behind your truck. We're also bringing the charm of farm life into your truck cabin with a set of delightful, agriculture-themed accessories. These decorations let you personalize your space and carry a piece of the countryside with you wherever you drive.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/47731ccfdc5bb89135812903f6bce02a28dd18e8.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/bc8ae2232f6ddb1041222c2457df543a994f8091.jpg"]
Included cabin accessories:

    Lunch Box

    Scarecrow

    Straw Hat

    Stuffed Autonomous Tractor

    Harvester Toy

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3f2e2f35425602f528095666b3346c5001b00f1d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d52fd7a8545f082812a6a4bb4d8d58d85599d88a.jpg"]

We can’t wait to see you hit the road with these new loads! Be sure to share your screenshots and videos of your first job with Farm Machinery DLC using the hashtag #ETS2FarmMachinery when posting on social media! As always, thank you for your continued support, and until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: 1.55 Update Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to share with you that the 1.55 Update for Euro Truck Simulator 2 is now released and available on Steam! Let's take a look at all the features you will encounter in this update.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/654baed9543974c1c4b728bb4b8083cc3de4384a.jpg"]

First of all, we would like to thank everyone in our #BestCommunityEver who took part in the Open Beta phase and helped us by reporting bugs on our forums. It really made it much easier for us to fine-tune the update and make it ready for the full release. 
[previewyoutube="JGY-seIMQMA;full"][/previewyoutube]


Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency 
[previewyoutube="jXEfpl0jWM0;full"][/previewyoutube]
This new Driving Academy module, called Truck Driving Proficiency, will introduce a set of much more challenging scenarios, which will test even the most skilled drivers to the limit. For this new module and set of scenarios, we will also introduce a new reward system. The most important thing is still to precisely complete a scenario by driving along the designated path and avoiding any collisions. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/627be37df9197d59ae9875fb731606eb12f8d3bd.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e76997bd0897e9bf2430f3821cb503edf19e02c1.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ada4116aa32a5f40f91a3d6a3503e2917ab1a021.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bc97dd42bae665b99ab4c0a0aa9ff9879a7c6d8a.jpg"]

Players will also be able to achieve up to 3 collectable stars in this module, which can be earned by meeting additional conditions such as only using the interior camera, limiting gear shifts between drive and reverse, or completing the scenario in the set time. To really test your skills, you won't find any pre-recorded video tutorials, and you will have to use all the knowledge we taught you in our first module of Driving Academy. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9442cc512d39c6c8589d3bff508d6de7b65c2cc1.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/27e7c1a4e714ad2778ee197b84759e33358e42b7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d53a62e8f9f5add8417ea418ba58ea48a26b24ed.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3bcf52bc98268ee6240d5df79e0846ce9e31e8a0.jpg"]

We've also prepared new, exciting rewards that players can use on the same profile in the base game! As you may know, finishing the first module grants a blue traffic cone cabin accessory and a customizable Driving Academy truck paint job. Completing all Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios unlocks an orange traffic cone accessory, while earning 3 stars in every scenario adds a matching trailer paint job and a golden traffic cone, giving your truck and trailer the full Driving Academy look.



Asynchronous Loading

We have been hard at work implementing a major overhaul in the way our game loads and processes data, a new system we call Asynchronous Loading. This system is designed to improve the loading process by ensuring that the game and loading screens remain uninterrupted while assets are loaded in the background. The primary benefit here is the mitigation of stuttering, resulting in a smoother experience overall. 

We'd like to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who shared their feedback during both the Experimental and Open Beta phases. Your input played a key role in helping us refine this system, and we're excited to share that Asynchronous Loading is now fully implemented with the release of the 1.55 update!  



FH Tuning Pack DLC Update

The FH Tuning Pack DLC will now be fully compatible with the Volvo FH Series 6 as well, so you'll be able to customize every Volvo FH truck with a wide range of tuning parts. But that's not all, as we are also improving several current components, introducing new customization options, along with paintable parts. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6b94a67fc0e7eb32dfd5852df112379d04119e18.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f2b2c4563153ce4ffaf364bf85d6f342ed210d21.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f2145f9d6d45cef2f79441faa948cc11094b1458.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5972d2d76793543eebe8d87eed95791a864d901b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6e15a60586f2e9fa9b7f92715d4d2b1f5eb2da79.jpg"]

You will be able to pick the front badge plate, rear fender top, front mask, and front grille bottom in chrome, while the decal, windshield frame, front badge plate, rear fender, rear fender top, and more are now paintable!  



Custom City Intros for the Vive la France ! DLC 

We have reworked all of the in-game intros for every city in France with an ownable garage, both in the base game and the Vive la France ! DLC. A total of 21 cities have received new or updated Custom City Intros.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/92f8cd00d82c5c94362042ec73f892fe1e9d8f1e.jpg"]

Mail UX Redesign 

The mail screen has been reworked to provide a cleaner layout and a smoother navigation experience. Messages are now displayed in a two-column format, with a scrollable list on the left and an enlarged message view on the right for better readability. Messages load from the top, and when the list gets longer, intuitive paging helps keep things tidy. Navigation has been improved across all input methods, and embedded links or actions can now be accessed directly from the message content.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/defc3e1202cc984428e76e22a861c96ef05d8955.jpg"]

Options QoL Improvements 

In this update, we've added a small but useful quality-of-life improvement to the graphics settings menu. You'll now see example screenshots next to various settings, giving you a better idea of how each option affects the game's visuals.  Whether you're tweaking things for smoother performance or aiming for the best possible look, these previews should make it easier to find the right balance for your setup. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/52c6553799a92423e367685c918ce5a2f964406a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3addd8ff679e55b4c263aa345b45ecefbea96a64.jpg"]

Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey

We are adding a "My Location" hotkey as part of our map improvements. When pressed, it instantly centers the game map on the player's current location. We hope you find this small addition useful on the road! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1bb7fd7d51ba2ba4c56ed38e38d38b5c36963a1f.jpg"]

Change of Steam Achievements

Our team is working around the clock on engine updates, many of which are not visible during regular gameplay. Some of these are visible instantly, such as new light systems, but we also need to work on changes that are not normally visible when you play.  Updating the achievement system gives us foundations that will allow us to make different and new types of achievements, as well as manage existing ones that often rely on different DLCs and regions. As a part of that, we have a new system coming out in 1.55.  Along with this new system, some small changes were made to existing achievements and their goals to prepare us for any changes future developments may bring. If you would like to share any feedback about this, you can do so on our forums.

Remember to stay tuned for more Euro Truck Simulator 2 updates by following us on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Bluesky, and YouTube. We would also really appreciate it if you could sign up for our newsletter. Until next time, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: 1.55 Update Open Beta
notes.notes:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ba02b3d5d64bc9bbb594b127e4399093644156e0.jpg"]

Let's take a closer look!


Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency
[previewyoutube="jXEfpl0jWM0;full"][/previewyoutube]
This new Driving Academy module, called Truck Driving Proficiency, will introduce a set of much more challenging scenarios, which will test even the most skilled drivers to the limit. For this new module and set of scenarios, we will also introduce a new reward system. The most important thing is still to precisely complete a scenario by driving along the designated path and avoiding any collisions. For proficiency level, there may be additional conditions you will have to meet to successfully pass the scenario.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9b1e808e75bf0b17dffd4019292a51525913bae7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8e13e3dfc6d654743cf43628c994c8eeda7ae1bb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6d2b30be11c30d237c930f2ef81507d33026b1d1.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/59e058b2cf0337e9eb91a315f4e8b3bc05f150ff.jpg"]

Players will be able to achieve up to 3 collectable stars in this module, which can be earned by meeting additional conditions such as only using the interior camera, limiting gear shifts between drive and reverse, or completing the scenario in the set time. You'll earn a reward for completing all the scenarios, and you can unlock additional rewards by collecting all 3 stars in each one.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5f8b310cc4d05a1e6c85f44ccc6244a7c871558e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/06b5d82c929754f7c30b473d027c536d4f675209.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5e1050b56af67ebe27c906c2485b410398a40757.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/079e4d912a7fe5f49f3e0c24b8be6bdb33b53956.jpg"]

To really test your skills, you won't find any pre-recorded video tutorials, and you will have to use all the knowledge we taught you in our first module of Driving Academy.

Asynchronous Loading

We have been hard at work implementing a major overhaul in the way our game loads and processes data, a new system we call Asynchronous Loading. This system is designed to improve the loading process by ensuring that the game and loading screens remain uninterrupted while assets are loaded in the background. The primary benefit here is the mitigation of stuttering, resulting in a smoother experience overall.

We'd like to thank everyone who contributed their feedback to the Experimental Beta in Euro Truck Simulator 2, which was centred around this new update. Your feedback was incredibly valuable to our team, and now we are happy to be able to continue to bring this new feature forward into the Open Beta. You can help us fine-tune this feature by reporting any unusual loading behaviour in the dedicated 1.55 forum section.

FH Tuning Pack Update

This DLC will now be fully compatible with the Volvo FH Series 6 as well, so you'll be able to customize every Volvo FH truck with a wide range of tuning parts. But that's not all, as we are also improving several current components, introducing new customization options, along with paintable parts.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/21d692c1db53e7af98cafd0868976684ab9e9b05.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/72a9505d48954537138feffc5b91f1a29d7988ea.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8c7901f4404ad99faa8a4fe20dd16a4905355aa2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3cad0d279b889e112618ca71c98ef9599246c8f2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/87b2a64e9d675e262bbfa3cca3605a1b07bb6f6d.jpg"]

You will be able to pick the front badge plate, rear fender top, front mask, and front grille bottom in chrome, while the decal, windshield frame, front badge plate, rear fender, rear fender top, and more are now paintable!

Custom City Intros for the Vive la France ! DLC

We have reworked all of the in-game intros for every city in France with an ownable garage, both in the base game and the Vive la France ! DLC. A total of 21 cities have received new or updated Custom City Intros.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d595e8e6e40f2026958b7c1ccea1cbacb16ea80b.jpg"]

Mail UX Redesign

The mail screen has been redesigned to enhance UI, UX, and controller navigation. It features two main sections: a mail list on the left and the mail content on the right, which is now larger for improved readability and easier to scroll through. Mails populate from the top, and when the list exceeds the screen, pagination is used. Users can navigate through emails using the arrow keys or the controller's D-pad, with emails opening instantly on selection. Mail content may include clickable or keybind-accessible embedded links.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1999a9a40915e0b8ef83c5677147f6cafed95047.jpg"]

Options QoL Improvements

In this update, we've added a small but useful quality-of-life improvement to the graphics settings menu. You'll now see example screenshots next to various settings, giving you a better idea of how each option affects the game's visuals.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/275dd6c0f843fa043ba5bc67e8bdb409a495ee1f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f2e9eae57956bb2e164fb38fb7900e09383dd760.jpg"]

Whether you're tweaking things for smoother performance or aiming for the best possible look, these previews should make it easier to find the right balance for your setup.

Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey

We are adding a "My Location" hotkey as part of our map improvements. When pressed, it instantly centers the game map on the player's current location. We hope you find this small addition useful on the road!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/344135134ce52811307725109d00788cf7d2f943.jpg"]

Change of Steam Achievements

Our team is working around the clock on engine updates, many of which are not visible during regular gameplay. Some of these are visible instantly, such as new light systems, but we also need to work on changes that are not normally visible when you play.

Updating the achievement system gives us foundations that will allow us to make different and new types of achievements, as well as manage existing ones that often rely on different DLCs and regions. As a part of that, we have a new system coming out in 1.55, which we would like to test in open beta. 

To ensure that the new code is well tested before release, some small changes were made to existing achievements and their goals to let us see if the changes we make are working smoothly for all of our users.

FH Tuning Pack Update for Volvo FH Series 6

notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - 1.54 Update Release
notes.notes:
Today, we are excited to release the 1.54 Update for Euro Truck Simulator 2! After the Open Beta, you can now try out all the features that this update has to offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/03e88fe2b422fe37f959aa6fa18b019143d04c97.jpg
Before we take a look at what's new, we would first like to thank everyone who took part in the Open Beta in the past few weeks. Your feedback really helped us fine-tune everything that was added in this version and made it possible to give you a polished set of features in this update. Now, let's take a look at what's in store!

Cargo System Redefined
Until now, what seemed like the game combining a trailer with cargo, such as a piece of machinery, was actually a manually created model, with each trailer-cargo pair stored separately on disk. This approach required an enormous number of unique models, making it harder to add new content efficiently and taking up disk space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/cc381eea01586735c978c0b1c27e4f9eb422badc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/689b66b9deed2ecfbba0cc624f50b53345ee5082.jpg
In the redefined cargo system, the code automatically merges cargo and trailers based on simplified rules. This means that each cargo will define its own model, loading methodology, and lashing method. This will make the work of our vehicle team much easier as it no longer requires our 3D artists to manually create pre-baked trailer-cargo pairs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3ab2836a21dd993a2fd0ce299ce4f8d2061dbf3d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/58e7ae5d57232add6fab559ea746bd166d450e8b.jpg
While there may be issues in the first iteration, it's a worthwhile goal to refine the system, as it not only improves efficiency but also saves disk space and memory by eliminating the need to store countless pre-made combinations. This project may also lead to other possibilities for both of our games, especially with dynamic cargo (un)loading and more. You can read about how this project was executed in our recent Under the Hood blog.

Truck Adjustment Menu Redesign
The Truck Adjustment Menu has been completely redesigned to provide a more user-friendly experience. Previously, each option for adjusting your driver's FOV, seat, mirrors etc had separate menus with different layouts. Now, they share a cohesive interface, making adjustments much more intuitive and easier. The new design also takes on a similar visual from our previous UI overhaul and is optimized for both a mouse and a controller, ensuring accessibility for all users.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/535d670d444ee764df25ded1bc0e9e5cfe7367be.jpg
For keyboard and mouse users, adjustments are now more streamlined with the use of the WASD keys for navigation, along with buttons for finer tuning. Meanwhile, controller users will find the new system much smoother, with the left stick controlling adjustments, the right stick handling camera movement for mirror positioning, and the D-pad or shoulder buttons navigating the menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3df1e159211f0f96ab4cc36e27f9f3a1e3f0e54e.jpg
The addition of shoulder button support makes menu navigation more fluid for controller players. This update makes adjusting mirrors and seats much easier, particularly for those using controllers, ensuring a more seamless and enjoyable driving experience. Accessing the Truck Adjustment Menu remains the same. You can use the F4 by default, a custom-assigned key of your choice, or through the adviser services menu. 

PhysX System Implementation
In 1.54, we are adopting the NVIDIA PhysX physics engine as an alternative to the current Bullet physics engine for low-level simulation of physics in the game world that players interact with. This shift allows players to experience more precise collision detection results and more robust behaviour during scenarios involving collisions between vehicles and obstacles or other vehicles. PhysX also offers our teams better debugging tools, which indirectly benefits players by helping resolve bugs more efficiently.

One of the most noticeable improvements brought by PhysX can already be experienced in our recently introduced Driving Academy game mode. For example, collisions with cones and obstacles are now more accurate and objects no longer appear to "levitate" slightly above the ground after interaction, a flaw that occurred with Bullet. While players may not see drastic changes, certain interactions should exhibit slightly improved behaviour.

During the Open Beta, many players expressed concerns about hardware limitations due to recent news that 32-bit version of PhysX would no longer be supported by certain GPUs. However, the PhysX implementation we use runs entirely on the CPU, meaning players can enjoy PhysX without worrying about graphics card compatibility.

With the release of version 1.54, PhysX is now the default physics engine for all gameplay. Players who prefer the previous Bullet physics engine can switch back by using the "-bullet" command line argument in their Steam launch options.

Driving Academy - Volvo FH Series 5, Volvo FH Series 6, and Iveco S-Way
We have implemented both the Volvo FH Series 5 and Volvo FH Series 6, as well as the Iveco S-Way into Driving Academy. These beautiful trucks were added to Euro Truck Simulator 2 in December, and now you can try them out in various challenging scenarios in Driving Academy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c8be4c36fb794ee29b9079872ac8377e98b68440.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3489af856f7b629954d703e66c055267654ef665.jpg
Driving Academy Rewards
Everyone who has already completed or will complete the entire first module of Driving Academy will receive special rewards to use inside the game on the same profile they completed the academy with - a hanging blue traffic cone cabin accessory and a customizable Driving Academy paint job for your truck. So make sure to complete your scenarios and grab your rewards, there will be more to come!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dde129df87fa2ec0549cd17f8b3e39a8399275c8.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4ad10069d73f697f67f8c7dd5c545ce0835fe236.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/01ae49317ac8260cb54d7ffd7e9aba5e5f3e75dc.jpg
Changelog

Gameplay

 Cargo System Redefined
 Driving Academy Rewards

Vehicles

 Volvo FH Series 5, Volvo FH Series 6, and Iveco S-Way added to Driving Academy

Visual

 Truck Adjustment Menu Redesign

Other

 PhysX Implementation

We hope that you will enjoy the new features, changes, and more that come with this update! Remember to follow us on our Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Bluesky, and YouTube, and share your pictures or videos from the game. We'd also really appreciate it if you could sign up for our newsletter to stay informed, even when you're not able to check out the blog or our socials. Keep on trucking!

Yesterday, we ended the #CruisingGreece World of Trucks event for Euro Truck Simulator 2. notes.title: Greece DLC Release
notes.notes:
Today is the day, engines at the ready! The Greece DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2 releases today and we can't wait for you to get on the road. Are you ready to discover the Land of Legends and Myths and all that it offers? Let's move into top gear! 

The Greece DLC is now available on Steam!
See our special launch page with our DLCs on sale here

[previewyoutube=TnstEfkCYFM;full][/previewyoutube]
We cannot wait for you to embark on your first journey into Greece. Our team has been working hard to ensure everything is running smoothly for its release. From bug smashing to making those final touches to the map, we're ready for you to explore and deliver across the country and its islands! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/2747ef9e34c7e76ae9355caee679011766df4167.jpg
Take your time and enjoy every moment as you discover:
 Explore 15 major cities across Greece, including Athens and Thessaloniki, alongside smaller towns and settlements.
 Travel via Ferry to the islands of  Lesbos, Chios, Kefalonia, Crete and Rhodes.
 Discover unique historical and natural landmarks including the Meteora Monasteries, the Fortress of Mytilene, Mount Olympus, the Corinth Canal and more!
 Travel through diverse terrains, from historical cities to coastal roads and mountainous regions.
 Drive across modern highways, winding country roads, and complex ports.
 Deliver to unique depots such as Hotels, olive oil processing plants, marble quarries, and the bustling Piraeus port.
 Discover a variety of viewpoints highlighting the Greek landscape and significant landmarks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/be4d22405d16e20914d872e9a21bb999834906f6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6d19ce551539c1245545110b43bb2e3d4ec683bb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f1ffc18e04a541d3f7e7eb4920e964379bb1fe42.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/97b4913214d4d3b2dfd0a56be1ee34c7de71d01e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d715d568ccf27c4c2512376b2e65685e09ed584a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/eeea966923a9126170a06a254def141dc48515de.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/aa8c0a22dc1d99216370610e39b51df356277631.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7071b6e72f60fd2bc18bf74b08e23d7434060a62.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1b32fb470f25e1242f89379fc70ebc45b7fb59ed.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c4c2103a14dfab4606334f8d856a11a89cfb60f4.jpg
From bustling historical cities to charming island gems, Greece offers something new to explore at every turn. Whether you're drawn to the coastline or the mountains, you'll find unique opportunities to experience the country's beauty. From delivering to custom hotel resorts and local industries to making deliveries to ports, marble processing plants, and more, Greece has something for everyone to enjoy and discover.

#CruisingGreece World of Trucks Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6c046d449c5e05d3a628e2c02e15cb5dccdf4e77.jpg

Introducing our newest World of Trucks Event, Cruising Greece! Embark on an epic journey through the legendary landscapes of Greece and its captivating islands, while contributing to its uniquely rich economy and earning special in-game Greek-themed rewards.

[previewyoutube=gFUK38kVSNA;full][/previewyoutube]
Earn a special Dolphin Paint Job for your truck when you complete your personal goal! To earn this, you must deliver cargo to or from all 15 of the explorable cities in Greece on a job contract that is over 200km in length. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a9e96f9d0afc9cdf8bd0707eb5569ce6c7169f33.jpg
Your personal progress will also help contribute to and complete the community goal of driving 200,000,000 km (124,274,238 miles) while delivering cargo to or from any city in Greece. Upon reaching this goal, all drivers who have completed their personal goal will receive an additional reward; a very cute Little Owl dashboard ornament!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d49d55b0b33c43c850075bfea8ee241dd2b3c2b9.jpg
But that's not all! We also have another unique gift for you. Complete any job using External Contracts or the External Market, TO or FROM the city of Mitilini, and you will receive a Donkey Plushie to accompany you on your journey, sporting a Greek-coloured bandana! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f6f85e5874a46ad7ca747b9f8d5a084922a9f8b6.jpg
The event will be concluded on Sunday the 2nd of February 2025 at 23:59 UTC. Want to learn more? Take a read of our dedicated blog which you can find here.

Greece Release Live Stream
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d7cf0428754af7cf36ffc44af3704e8a6166aab6.jpg
Join us for our special Greece DLC Release Live Stream as we count down to the release time! The stream will feature special guests involved in developing this exciting new expansion, and our CEO, Pavel Šebor. We’ll also be trucking through Greece the entire time and hosting giveaways. Don’t miss out! Join us at our official Twitch or YouTube channels today from 4:00 PM CET to be part of the release party!

Heavy Cargo Pack DLC Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/fe002a36f4f528b516ed1d4e86f84f9e25f2c2ee.jpg
We're excited to share that the Heavy Cargo Pack DLC for Euro Truck Simulator 2 will also receive a free update containing 3 new cargos to haul across Greece and beyond! Drivers looking for a more challenging job contract can now find these new heavy and specialised machinery equipment: 

Mobile Crusher: A powerful machine designed to crush large rocks and materials into smaller, usable sizes directly at the quarry site.

Mobile Screening Plant: A portable unit for efficiently separating and sorting materials by size to meet specific project requirements.

Mobile Stacker: A versatile conveyor system for stacking and transporting processed materials into organized stockpiles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1cdf6fb0f228ff01995db6d9b570df3262e1bafb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/cd2614ec66c2b5025fcb4f46d622f582f2caf5e3.jpg
Each one of these cargoes has been recreated in detail by our talented vehicle and artist teams. We hope that you enjoy hauling each one of these challenging cargos on your travels. Send your screenshots and videos to us on our official social media channels. Happy Truckin'!

notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: 1.53 Update Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to share with our community that the 1.53 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2 is now officially released! Packed with new content, reworked content, quality of life improvements and more, let's dive in and take a look at what's in store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ac86656a02107a4f482b264b0d1f757e1463afd5.jpg

Before that, we have to give a huge shoutout to everyone who participated in the Open Beta phase, shared feedback, and reported bugs. Your invaluable contributions have allowed us to fine-tune content and eliminate bugs that slipped through the cracks initially. We hope that you will enjoy the new features, changes, and more that come with this update!

[previewyoutube=gzE7mONLRsY;full][/previewyoutube]
Germany Rework

As part of our Germany Rework project, we are excited to present the cities of München, Mannheim, Leipzig, Dresden and Germany's largest city and capital, Berlin. Each of these cities has been completely reworked from the ground up and is included for free as part of the 1.53 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/35bd9da826459a3e89bd23cd0439b5778ff0df4a.jpg
With the help of advanced map techniques and technologies, our team has been able to rework each city and its surrounding area in great detail, including accurately represented industries in the area, new and improved road networks, and famous local landmarks! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/cd3535de77a971e1a338f7db204218910313b837.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b4d49c184ea48e2cc1b0226de10a81ae966b1016.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/956095e7b03617c666ad07088e549e899cfa2e65.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/edd7a96389cb5e1e115d0aa71cbf25c51b026d9b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b54297e81c465402d8dd23c22e9a7bbd63167d4b.jpg
We encourage you to explore each of these cities yourself, and discover what each one has to offer; you'll never know what you may find! If you're interested in learning more in more detail about each specific city, be sure to check out our dedicated blogs on the Germany rework, which you can find here. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/be5bdaa85eddb398d00fb513eac809e74e0dd8de.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3e2667e21ad4fd72d995e60d0c98bfc84197145e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/25c4062e01b81d4ef429dbe44cc2dcf126f019a7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b737afaade06978752937c50a56009fa3308c563.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6eca286c365fba043d5abe39be3ab23347ad8ae2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/102fb3527781b8135f306ae4030570a724bd0f60.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/650a333a7ad2b73cfd2e6fb5349f1f045afa828f.jpg
Volvo FH Series 4 Rework

We're excited to announce that the Volvo FH Series 4 has undergone a complete rework in the 1.53 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2! We know the community has been eagerly awaiting news on this highly requested update, so without further ado, let's take a closer look at the changes made to this iconic truck. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/318e81a20b26d9c7f65c3edb5bcd9622fda6ea2b.jpg
Let's start with the cabin, which has been completely reworked both inside and out. Thanks to newly provided CAD data, we have been able to accurately improve details and the accuracy of external parts including front and rear fenders, bumpers, roof deflectors, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c18846549c80dd700891f2630d632acb273988fd.jpg
The same goes for the interior too, which now features more accurate textures and materials that meet the new Volvo standard. Drivers will also have the option of choosing between different interior trims, customisable seats, and steering wheel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/96b7f682fc3e2394946c83c697c4ce79ec5cf2db.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9df8a5e8fa952a090543dde337d7f4bde1d93617.jpg
The chassis of the Volvo FH Series 4 has also been completely remodelled and improved in terms of details, including new textures for a better overall appearance. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/4b9ee72397d20e96a663e7c876298e2bab5457e1.jpg
However, that isn't all! The Volvo FH Tuning Pack has also received a rework as a result of the Volvo FH Series 4 being overhauled. Owners of this DLC Pack can expect reworked tuning parts, including the front and rear fenders, bumpers, roof deflectors, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/869ece88313476877fb8c970129ca32c51dcf6c1.jpg
Drivers can also find an option to paint their cabin in the special 25 Years of Volvo FH paint livery! It's the perfect way to celebrate the rework of the Volvo FH Series 4 in style. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/889c39b944649d5c20cc140df92e6366858fcadb.jpg
We look forward to hearing your initial reactions on the rework of this iconic truck, which our team has worked hard to enhance with new details and improvements. Be sure to share your comments, screenshots, and videos with us across our social media channels!

Options QoL improvement

We're happy to introduce a feature that we believe many players will find helpful, especially those who often adjust their settings to fine-tune what is best to their liking and setup. When changing an option with a default value, players will now have a visual indication of when a setting has been moved or changed from its default state. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/001d2d530c0747d2f964313bc79f027c5245dc5e.jpg
Settings that have been adjusted from their default value will now appear with a small visual indicator alongside that setting. We hope this helps users find which settings have been altered from default. 

Smooth and Auto Camera Centring

Another new feature that we are happy to include with this update is Smooth and Auto Camera Centring! Players can now enable this new option to return their camera to the central position automatically after moving it. When activated by the player or by moving forward, the smooth centring feature becomes noticeable as it gently transitions the camera to the central position.

This addition comes with a range of personal preference options, including three options for speed, which controls how fast or slow the camera returns to the centre; as well as the option to set how many seconds of delay there should be before re-centring occurs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/1c4de942a1b173a6fd66717fb99f7b547d8d0ac8.jpg
For players who use a third-party head-tracking solution or prefer to adjust the position of the camera manually, there is also an option to disable this feature altogether. Happy trucking!

 Visualization of changed options in the settings

notes.title: Pinktober 2024 Update
notes.notes:
With October already behind us, we wanted to share with you an update on our Pinktober 2024 campaign. Since 2019, we are proud to have continued to raise awareness and support for this important topic. If you missed our previous blog post all about this special month, we recommend that you read about it here. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a0bdf0c2f63a29bd4fd196bdb0f0b6cff8308223.jpg

Whether that be through sharing #Pinktober screenshots, tuning into our live streams or hosting your own charity convoys, these seemingly small gestures play an important role in the fight against this widespread disease. 

We'd also like to thank you, our #BestCommunityEver, who have helped us raise donations through the sales of our Pink Ribbon Charity Packs for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. We're happy to share that the amount raised from this year's sales of this special Paint Job Pack is a staggering 54,000 USD! This sum is truly remarkable, and we extend our gratitude to each and every one of you. We believe that contributing the entire amount to the Alliance of Women with Breast Cancer will make a significant difference in supporting those who need it most.

Although Pinktober has ended for another year, we encourage you to continue to prioritise your health by practising self-checks, seeing your doctor regularly, and promoting healthy habits with those around you all year round! notes.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - 1.53 Update: Open Beta
notes.notes:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.53 Open Beta branch for Euro Truck Simulator 2 is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the appropriate section(s) of our official forums.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/10ed1c4c09c2929e354ab780feed27b2c0411899.jpg

Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.53 Open Beta has in store.

Germany Rework
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/0f433edd1397070b5462e7aae88ecae5e4a1941b.jpg
As part of our Germany Rework project, we are excited to present the cities of München, Mannheim, Leipzig, Dresden and Germany's largest city and capital, Berlin. Each of these cities has been completely reworked from the ground up and are included for free as part of the 1.53 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7374fb403cc00e33599397a5d56bbf31110c4bef.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/47f32517003a4ab076541d074309024e6ec04a07.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c2c96e5f9fca9dac68c6da7052c532fc88f630f4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d3814ee4ae6987a90f668761d5288fbce345b5c2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/379a52f71273ab13193862440553b0fb5d4980b7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e5e001666a682ac569fb1257a4a4a8bc45aaae41.jpg
With the help of advanced map techniques and technologies, our team has been able to rework each city and its surrounding area in great detail, including accurately represented industries in the area, new and improved road networks, and famous local landmarks! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3ab2c185a08705bac023fe6d1d23034df3cfcd9b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/5975414857e9b5212be3681186c7287c3a7afcc4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/8a3aff8e55c47c33ae2285627b905b714bafb821.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/0b9c8ede5260f4c564b4d3363bbcaa6cb49abb96.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/940dc8cceb2564546151ea9dae5881ad2ac2e885.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/af9e83f13d92f9f369577ed9c5189700c23a4cc5.jpg
We encourage you to explore each of these cities yourself, and discover what each one has to offer; you'll never know what you may find! If you're interested in learning more in more detail about each specific city, be sure to check out our dedicated blogs on the Germany rework, which you can find here. 

Volvo FH Series 4 Rework
We're excited to announce that the Volvo FH Series 4 has undergone a complete rework in the 1.53 update for Euro Truck Simulator 2! We know the community has been eagerly awaiting news on this highly requested update, so without further ado, let's take a closer look at the changes made to this iconic truck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b2510b88e1c05d29185921760eb63f17e8eee1c5.jpg
Let's start with the cabin, which has been completely reworked both inside and out. Thanks to newly provided CAD data, we have been able to accurately improve details and the accuracy of external parts including front and rear fenders, bumpers, roof deflectors, and more.

The same goes for the interior too, which now features more accurate textures and materials that meet the new Volvo standard. Drivers will also have the option of choosing between different interior trims, as well as selectable seats and steering wheel. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ba49acff15967d773955ba0feda61ba59d1bcc99.jpg
The chassis of the Volvo FH Series 4 has also been completely remodeled and improved in terms of details, including new textures for a better overall appearance. 

However, that isn't all! The Volvo FH Tuning Pack has also received a rework as a result of the Volvo FH Series 4 being overhauled. Owners of this DLC Pack can expect reworked tuning parts, including the front and rear fenders, bumpers, roof deflectors, and more. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d1707cfe7fa7850ba7ba2f0acb7b3eb37ded1ecc.jpg
Drivers can also find an option to paint their cabin in the special 25 Years of Volvo FH paint livery! It's the perfect way to celebrate the rework of the Volvo FH Series 4 in style.

We look forward to hearing your initial reactions to the rework of this iconic truck, which our team has worked hard to enhance with new details and improvements. Be sure to share your comments, screenshots, and videos with us across our social media channels!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a8f7dcc16d77ba6f03471f36434b42be245dbf83.jpg
Please note, however, that this truck is still a work in progress, with some parts and options still being finalized. Whilst we aim to have this truck fully polished and complete by the end of the Open Beta, your feedback and reports would be incredibly helpful during this final phase. You can report any bugs or issues to the relevant feedback forum here.

Options QoL improvement
We're happy to introduce a feature that we believe many players will find helpful, especially those who often adjust their settings to fine-tune what is best to their liking and setup. When changing an option with a default value, players will now have a visual indication of when a setting has been moved or changed from its default state. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/82f4118df058efbc451427619c18119e862ba5fc.jpg
Settings that have been adjusted from their default value will now appear with a small visual indicator alongside that setting. We hope this helps users find which settings have been altered from default. 

Smooth and Auto Camera Centring
Another new feature that we are happy to include with this update is Smooth and Auto Camera Centring! Players can now enable this new option to return their camera to the central position automatically after moving it. When activated by the player or by moving forward, the smooth centring feature becomes noticeable as it gently transitions the camera to the central position.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/af4e2e4719c6900cb3bbc45fd11c2d14937b7457.jpg
This addition comes with a range of personal preference options, including three options of speed, which controls how fast or slow the camera returns to the centre; as well as the option to set how many seconds of delay there should be before re-centring occurs.

For players who use a third-party head-tracking solution or prefer to adjust the position of the camera manually, also have the option to disable this feature altogether. Happy trucking! 

Changelog
Map 

 Germany Rework project - München, Mannheim, Leipzig, Dresden and Berlin
Vehicle 

 Volvo FH Series 4 Rework
UI

 Default settings value change indication 
 Smooth and Auto camera centring

So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in this section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on Euro Truck Simulator 2 → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.53. No password is required. Sometimes you may have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.

notes.title: Driving Academy Release
notes.notes:
Today, we are very happy to announce that Driving Academy is now available for Euro Truck Simulator 2! A few weeks ago, we announced this new game module in this blog and showed you a preview of it in some of our live streams, and now you can finally try it out for yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1cfe871d0f77b58dadbbdc4125669b3efa6eefa8.jpg
As was mentioned in the previous blog we released about Driving Academy, we are venturing into new territory, inspired by years of feedback from players who have told us that our games have helped them grasp the basics of truck driving. Many have used it to get a sense of handling a truck and trailer, learning how to maneuver and reverse. With this in mind, we thought we'd take it a step further with this free update which includes sets of scenarios designed to improve and expand these skills in a fun and captivating way. 

We've prepared a short video just for you, explaining everything you need to know about Driving Academy. It also includes a brief yet comprehensive guide on how to get started and make the most out of the game module.

[previewyoutube=fav9uncyvYA;full][/previewyoutube]
This new game module will provide you with various scenarios of increasing difficulty inspired by instructions given to real-life students. You will go from basic driving to navigating intricate courses and complex parking maneuvers with a detailed explanation via driving instructions including diagrams, pointers, and directions. We also wanted to allow drivers to analyze their drive so we have implemented a new replay feature into this game module as well.

notes.title: 1.53 Update: Germany Rework
notes.notes:
Yes, you read that correctly! Today we're happy to share with you a preview into the next phase of the Germany Rework for Euro Truck Simulator 2, which is currently planned to be completed for the 1.53 update. This phase features several cities from across Germany, each which have been completely reworked from the ground up. Let's take a closer look, shall we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/7374fb403cc00e33599397a5d56bbf31110c4bef.jpg
München
Welcome to the Capital of Bavaria! Best known for its annual Oktoberfest celebrations and its numerous architectural & cultural attractions, it is the third largest city in Germany. When reworking this city, we paid close attention to the real life layout of the road network and junctions which truck drivers use to enter in and out of city, and recreated it to the best of our ability and scale limits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e2d46d92734a77a1f676e120d1e49bf230ad4ea7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/c2c96e5f9fca9dac68c6da7052c532fc88f630f4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f9ba0d41e0163f03b7401a12388bef7d5c483bf4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d3814ee4ae6987a90f668761d5288fbce345b5c2.jpg
Whilst truck drivers will be unable to visit the historical part of München (for now..), drivers will find a completely new industry area located north of the western junction (Roads 99/304), which features  a new garage and new truck dealers. This includes a very well known car manufacturer, who has their HQ here, which is featured alongside some new and existing landmarks. 

Mannheim 
Mannheim is the city of inventions! As the birthplace of the car, the bicycle and the tractor, it continues to be a centre of invention and progress today. Because of this, the city has a rich cultural and economic heritage. You won't only find the city reworked, but also the whole surrounding area. This includes the addition of a part of the Bundesautobahn 6. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/0b9c8ede5260f4c564b4d3363bbcaa6cb49abb96.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b494761e5910b6a5ea87ed01e4140e85b195e304.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/8a3aff8e55c47c33ae2285627b905b714bafb821.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/5975414857e9b5212be3681186c7287c3a7afcc4.jpg
Industry-wise, you'll find the HQ of the largest chemical producer in the world, and a petroleum industry. We've also added in the north-west a new junction which now leads to the L527 road. With this addition, our rework team was also able to squeeze in the village of Maxdorf. You'll also find some familiar roads and industries which have been reworked, such as the R1 road which leads to the sawmill and quarry. 

Leipzig
Arts, culture, music and more, Leipzig has it all! Whilst a relatively small city, there is still plenty for truckers to explore here, including a variety of historical landmarks, including the Opera House, which was opened in 1693, the University of Leipzig, which is one of the world's oldest universities and the the Leipzig Hauptbahnhof (Train Station) which at the time of its opening, was one of the largest in the world! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/ed4bb6f6f1fac43e1df19619d0c7cd384f8faf8c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/526a2eba99eb8a7d1b34ce5210b9a34b264f9ec5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/d61c618973b06b7142972107277571e2f2a86069.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/33ae8e1cbe0a88d4412816ff933be3a69f6cefdf.jpg
If you're living in Europe and received a package, chances are that it has travelled through Leipzig Airport! As one of the top four cargo hubs in Europe, thanks to its round-the-clock operations, its freight volume totals more than 1.4 million tons a year. We're happy to have the opportunity to include this major delivery point for our players in this rework. 

Dresden 
As the capital of the Saxony, Dresden has a variety of museums, historical relics and features some of the most fantastic Baroque architecture in Germany. Our team has reworked the city and the road network which truckers most frequently use around it. You'll find plenty of landmarks in the area, as well as art murals which can be found on the viaducts across Dresden. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/5ac73f01d43fd653d60463f8f63bd597438d9188.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/f25869fbbd49ca8724b1b1d04457779b6de5343d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/379a52f71273ab13193862440553b0fb5d4980b7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3c7abf86fefaf6af1c11b2de38f0a4c144ac4f4b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/e5e001666a682ac569fb1257a4a4a8bc45aaae41.jpg
Economy-wise, the team concentrated mostly on industries found in and around the Port of Dresden. This of course includes the river port too. We hope you like the work and detail that has been put into this historical, but bustling city! 

We really hope you enjoyed this preview into the major rework that is being undertaken by the team, be sure to let them know what you think of their work so far on our Social Media channels, we'd love to hear from you. However, there is still one more city which we've yet to cover, BE sure to keep an eye out for a future blog, because it's gonna be big. Bis zum nächsten Mal!

notes.title: KRONE Trailer Pack Update: Trailer Dynamics eTrailer
notes.notes:
Today, we're excited to bring innovation and modern technology to the world of virtual trucking. As you may remember, last year, KRONE Trailers invited us to be a part of their trailer technology revolution, giving us an insight into their work with Trailer Dynamics, and today we are excited to fulfill our promise by implementing it into the KRONE Trailer Pack for Euro Truck Simulator 2.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/39036e112a51b7524a25d3ceb5f9d070d6ab596e.jpg
Introducing the KRONE eTrailer! This collaboration between Krone Trailers and Trailer Dynamics has resulted in special electrified trailers that reduce the diesel consumption and CO2 emissions of a semitrailer tractor by 20 to 40 percent.

The core of this is a powerful electric drivetrain, which supports the drive of the semitrailer and tractor while also recovering braking energy through recuperation. The eAxis delivers 360 kW continuously and up to 580 kW at peak.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c5ca4f4a19a4caa01248fc1d671c892068464487.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/121f2e986aaf5e53ee2584b2fa413ac2319db232.jpg
For now, the KRONE eTrailer will only be available on the Freight Market, for shorter jobs under 350km and when hauling certain cargoes only. Players who find these job contracts will have the choice of two of these revolutionary Krone eTrailers, the eDry Liner and the eCool Liner. We look forward to having you experience how big of an improvement this provides for your fuel economy, as well as how powerful these trailers are!

We cannot thank our partners at KRONE Trailer enough for allowing us to bring their revolutionary eTrailer into Euro Truck Simulator 2, and we praise them for delivering the future and for leading the way with more economical and cleaner technology on our roads.
